text:
maria: Quick sync — pulling a benchmark narrative + webinar for launch. Need: one short blog, 3 charts (hero + 2 deep dives), 30m webinar, and inbound routing rules.

sam: Suggested hooks: 1) tokens->dollars, 2) tail latency risk (p99), 3) throughput economics with batching.

maria: Hero idea: simple econ claim + single chart mapping median latency vs cost per 1k tokens across model tiers. Two-line headline.

tess: Webinar run: 10m findings, 10m config demo (batching, prefix cache, quant), 10m Q&A + signup CTA. Keeps it tactical.

leo: Routing: distinguish SMB devs vs infra teams. If they download PDF or click "Dedicated", route to AE+SE. Add "primary use case" on form.

zach: Hero copy options: "Cut inference cost by up to Xx without hurting latency" / "Same latency, fewer dollars". Use conservative claim in copy.

maria: Chart specs (brief): hero_latency_cost: line chart cost_per_1k -> median_latency; tail_latency: percentile->latency area (redwood vs comp); throughput_econ: bar chart cost per 1k responses by batch size. Call out assumptions: hardware, prompt lengths, model family.

sam: For numbers, use conditional language: "Up to 5x cheaper in our tests; typical customers 2x-3x with batch+cache". Link methodology.

tess: Webinar CTA: "See the benchmark + run your slice with our eval kit — free run on Redwood Dedicated". Offer enterprise office hours.

leo: Quick routing rules: if webinar_attendee AND company_size>=250 -> AE outreach; if clicked_pdf AND visited_pricing -> AE+SE; else -> nurture emails + quickstart.

zach: Microcopy A/B ideas: 1) "Latency at scale, not latency at cost." 2) "Pay less per token, keep the experience." 3) "Faster inference, smarter economics." Prefer #3 for neutral tone.

maria: Action items: sam -> blog lead + chart mocks; sam+maria -> methodology note; maria -> one-pager outline + slides; zach -> run microcopy A/B; leo -> routing JSON. Target drafts by EOD Thursday.

marketing-bot: Webinar created: https://cal.link/redwood-bench-webinar — Tue 11am / Wed 3pm / Thu 10am.

sam: I'll upload SVG mocks and a 2-paragraph blog lead by 5pm.

tess: I'll share run-of-show and demo scripts by EOD.

maria: Great. Keep claims conservative and make charts reproducible (link to eval scripts). Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
